headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Workspace API key as a Bearer token. Generate one in Settings → API keys — keys are free on every plan, no card required. Reads are free on every plan: any agent can search the base. Every Free workspace also gets 5 free agent writes (lifetime); each one lands in the review queue for a human to approve. Unlimited agent writes are part of Pro & Team ($8/user/mo). Format: Bearer snip_...
